book.title: Plasma Simulation Primer
book.audience: student who knows basic mechanics, new to plasma

modules.title: What a plasma is and how its particles move
modules.subtitle: From a gas that conducts electricity to the spiral paths of single charges.

lessons.title: A gas that behaves as a crowd
objectives: Explain why a plasma counts as a separate state of matter
Describe the Debye length as the screening distance of a charge
Recognise quasi-neutrality at scales larger than the Debye length

lessons.title: Spiralling charges
objectives: Explain how a charged particle moves in a uniform magnetic field
Define the Larmor radius and the gyrofrequency
Predict the E cross B drift when an electric field is added
